d: We are looking for a skilled and adaptable Cake Decorator to join the production team of a fast-growing company operating across multiple markets. You will play a hands-on role in supporting baking operations, while also assisting with basic cake decoration and finishing, ensuring every order is produced to a consistent standard of quality, presentation, and freshness.

In this role, you will be part of the production operation responsible for preparing and baking products, while ensuring every product meets quality, consistency, and food safety standards. This is a cross-trained position, where you will primarily support baking activities while also assisting with cake decoration and finishing based on production needs.
Carry out baking-line activities including mixing, portioning, baking, and other production tasks
Assist with basic cake decoration, including piping, drawing, and finishing
Support senior decorators with cake orders when required
Follow standard recipes, decorating guidelines, and production processes consistently
Move between decorating and baking sections based on production volume and operational requirements
Ensure products are completed accurately and to the required quality and presentation standards
Maintain consistent baking and decorating techniques across different orders
Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace safety standards at all times
Monitor ingredients and materials and flag shortages or production issues to the relevant section lead
Work collaboratively with the wider production team to ensure orders are completed on time
Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient working environment
q: 2-4 years of experience in baking, pastry, or a similar production environment
Hands-on baking experience, including mixing, portioning, and baking
Basic cake decorating skills, including piping and finishing
Comfortable moving between decorating and baking tasks based on production requirements
Consistent and reliable technique with strong attention to detail
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment
Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards
Reliable, flexible, and willing to support different areas of production when needed
Ability to follow standardized recipes, processes, and quality guidelines consistently
Passion for baking and creating high-quality products

d: We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Infrastructure & Security Engineer to take operational ownership of enterprise Active Directory, hybrid identity, Microsoft 365, Windows Server infrastructure, and security operations. The role focuses on proactive infrastructure management, security hardening, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, business continuity, and continuous improvement under an SLA-driven managed services model.
q: Minimum 5–7 years of hands-on experience in enterprise Microsoft infrastructure, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and security operations.
Strong expertise in hybrid identity, Group Policy, Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, privileged access management, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Practical experience with Microsoft Defender, Intune, Conditional Access, PIM, vulnerability management, security hardening, and incident investigation.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel, Purview, DLP, AD CS/PKI, virtualization, backup and disaster recovery, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience with patch and change management, SLA-driven managed services, root cause analysis, technical reporting, and security remediation verification.
Strong documentation, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and independent operational ownership skills.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, preferably Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or Security Operations/Security Administrator Associate.

Preferred: Experience in regulated enterprise environments, Microsoft security improvement projects, enterprise managed services, and delivery of Microsoft-certified training or structured knowledge transfer.
Location: Muscat - EMBM, Muscat, Muscat, Oman
r: li

Active Directory & Identity: Manage on-premises/hybrid Active Directory, Domain Controllers, Group Policy, DNS, replication, trusts, privileged and service accounts, delegation, and AD CS/PKI where applicable. Implement AD hardening, reduce legacy authentication risks, and remediate privilege-escalation attack paths.
li
Microsoft 365 & Entra ID: Administer Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, and identity lifecycle controls.
li

Microsoft Security & Compliance: Configure and optimize Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Sentinel, Intune, Windows Hello for Business, Endpoint Privilege Management, Windows LAPS, Microsoft Purview, and DLP, using available licensed capabilities wherever possible.
li

Privileged Access & Secure Administration: Implement Tier 0/1/2 administration, least privilege, separate administrative accounts, just-in-time access where supported, emergency-access controls, secure administrative workstations, and phishing-resistant MFA for designated privileged users.
li

Server & Endpoint Hardening: Implement and maintain security baselines covering firewalls, EDR/antivirus, attack surface reduction, Credential Guard, LSASS protection, Secure Boot, BitLocker, application control, PowerShell, RDP, SMB, auditing, and cryptographic settings where supported, Monitor and troubleshoot the Servers including Microsoft, Linux servers.
li

Infrastructure Operations: Monitor and maintain Windows servers, endpoints, physical and virtual infrastructure, file and application servers, and agreed Linux/third-party components. Perform health checks, performance optimization, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and operational maintenance.
li

Vulnerability & Patch Management: Identify, prioritize, remediate, and verify vulnerabilities across supported servers, endpoints, applications, and infrastructure. Manage patching, configuration compliance, rescanning, exception tracking, and remediation evidence through approved change controls and maintenance windows.
li

Security Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor service and security health, validate alerts, investigate incidents, support threat response, integrate agreed telemetry with Sentinel, maintain detection use cases, and validate security controls and approved attack simulations.
li

Backup, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity: Oversee backup health and security, protect recovery copies, maintain disaster recovery and failover/failback procedures, and conduct approved restoration and resilience tests against agreed recovery objectives.
li

Managed Services & Governance: Handle incidents, service requests, problem management, root cause analysis, changes, escalations, SLA/KPI reporting, risk registers, and continuous service improvement. Maintain asset inventories, technical documentation, runbooks, and approved security exceptions.
li

Assessment & Continuous Improvement: Conduct infrastructure and security assessments, identify gaps, map applicable Authority and Oman cybersecurity requirements, maintain remediation roadmaps, and provide periodic security posture, infrastructure health, and lifecycle reports.
li

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Maintain accurate as-built configurations, operational procedures, recovery guides, and knowledge articles. Support administrator training and knowledge transfer, including Arabic and English documentation where required.

d: KBR’s Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) group is looking for a Lead HSE Engineer to support HSE function on PMC Project with Kuwait Oil Company in Kuwait.
The Lead HSE engineer will coordinate implementation of the KOC PMC Safety policies, HSE Management System and Project specific HSE Management Plans as they apply to the project.
He will ensure that the site complies with the relevant HSE Legislation and KOC HSE requirements.
He will develop and implement the project HSE MS.
He will develop and maintain Statistical data for the Project and prepare reports as required for the KBR KOC PMC HSEQ Manager.
q: Minimum 8 years Oil & Gas post-graduation experience
Minimum 5 years’ experience in a Lead HSE Engineer role.
Practical experience of design, construction, commissioning and maintenance aspects of oil/gas installations.

Practical experience with HSE management systems, reporting and audit procedures. Excellent written coordination and verbal communication skills. Ability to develop, update and maintain in-house procedures. Must be conversant with local and international saftey standards and norms.

Must possess two or more HSE certifications (certified courses) in General Industrial Safety, Construction Safety, Environmental Management, industrial Hygiene, ISO 14001 / OHSAS 18001 Lead Auditor, NEBOSH, ICertOSH, ASSE Certificate in Global Safety Management or equivalent courses.
r: li

Monitor the EPC contractor HSE Management System and provide advice and assistance to EPC HSE managers so they comply in a consistent way to reduce the risk to the project employees and the environment.
li
Ensure the EPC contractors develop implement and maintain a specific project Risk Management Plan
li
Ensure EPC contractor subcontractor selection (ITB) processes are developed and implemented on a timely basis in accordance with KOC expectations.
li
Provide advice and guidance to the EPC contractor management team on HSE issues through the interpretation of KOC policies and statutory requirements.
li

Ensure EPC contractors establish and maintain statistical data concerning all matters of health and safety, training programs with which to provide a basis for development of further health and safety activities, to highlight trends for future action.
li

Monitor compliance with all Kuwait legislative requirements including the dissemination of information to PMC and EPC managers and employees regarding amendments/ additions to requirements as they come into effect.
li
Review EPC contractor Safety Management System and advise of required changes.
li
Develop and maintain professional relationships with KOC, regulatory bodies and EPC contractors to foster the professional image of KBR.
li

Visit the project site on a regular basis to ensure interest and awareness of HSE is maintained, conduct regular safety talks and safety training sessions relative to the nature of activities being undertaken
p
Other key activities shall include but not be limited to the following:
li
Pro-actively visit site and with the EPC contractor implement safety measures-promote/ensure safe work practices
li
Ensure quality safety observation program is implemented and maintained on each site/project and ensure follow up on findings
li
Assist EPC contractor construction management personnel in identifying hazards and in planning and organizing the work such that a safe working environment is maintained.
li
Assist EPC sub-contractor Safety advisors and site management in the development and revision of specific site safety programmes.
li
Maintain a HS&E audit and assessment program for the location.
li
Carry out regular inspections of the work areas with the respective EPC contractor line manager and or HSE representative and prepare reports.
li
Disseminate safety information throughout the workplace via bulletin boards, posters, newsletters etc.
li
Assist EPC contractor line management and or construction supervisors in accident investigation process and report accordingly.
li
Develop and implement safety initiatives to continually improve, achieve and maintain stated safety performance and objectives.
li
Ensure HSE safety inductions are undertaken in accordance with the EPC contractor SMS requirements for all new employees of the company and its subcontractors
li
Monitor the availability and use of safety apparel and equipment.
li
Provide advice to the EPC subcontractor supervision on the development of project specific procedures and Job Safety Analysis (JSA) training,
li
Advise subcontractor supervisory staff and employees in the implementation of strategies to identify and control potential hazards and in the use of the hierarchy of controls
li
Ensure all lines of communication on HSE-matters remain open and effective between all parties particularly KOC,KBR, EPC contractors and their sub-contractors.
